name: Continental
sub: Radar; Tier-1 integrators; Cybersecurity via Argus
leadership: Christian Kotz, CEO since 1 January 2026; Frank Petznick, head of the Autonomous Mobility business area
about: Major Tier-1 automotive supplier providing radar, camera, lidar-related integration, braking, safety and ADAS systems.
model: Sells sensors, domain controllers, software and integrated systems to OEMs.
deployment: Global OEM supply; autonomy-specific program exposure varies by OEM and region.
metrics: Continues as a core Tier-1 ADAS supplier while Europe restructures automotive software alliances
signal: Continental is a key enabling layer where AVs need production-grade components rather than prototypes.

sources.title: Christian Kotz Appointed CEO of Continental
